parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system syslog file messages any warn.command: set system syslog file messages any warning
set system syslog file messages any warn.explanation: 配置系统日志文件，记录任何警告级别的日志。

parameters.name: severity
parameters.explanation: 日志的严重级别，例如any表示任何级别。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: 日志的具体级别，例如warning表示警告级别。

set system login user vty0 authenticatio.template: set system login user [parameter1] authentication plain-text-password [parameter2]
set system login user vty0 authenticatio.command: set system login user vty0 authentication plain-text-password "$1c$+ml_E.a0;2${3#YMMJkS;|55pT,![V6_S;%Ch53r1+)m;UL('kC$"
set system login user vty0 authenticatio.explanation: 配置系统登录用户的认证方式为明文密码。

set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.command: set firewall family inet filter anti-virus term deny-icmp from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤规则，拒绝ICMP协议的数据包。

set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.command: set firewall family inet filter anti-virus term deny-icmp then discard
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤规则的动作，丢弃匹配的数据包。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配数据包执行的动作，例如discard表示丢弃。

set class-of-service classifiers firewal.explanation: 配置服务质量（QoS）的分类器，基于防火墙过滤器。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter input [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet filter input anti-virus
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的输入方向防火墙过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter output [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet filter output anti-virus
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的输出方向防火墙过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
